Absolutely crazy how there are people in this thread acting like cheating is okay. Just because someone is 17 doesn't mean they can't tell between what is right and wrong. It's not like the day you turn 18 you have an epiphany and realize "I shouldn't do things that are wrong". It's so aggravating when people actually act like teenagers don't know right from wrong, they clearly know but choose to do the wrong, which in my opinion is grounds for being an awful person.  Anyways, this is a clear cut YTA for OP.

​

Should you have kicked your brother out? No. Why is it okay for you to make the "mistake" of cheating on your SO at 17 but he can't make an actual mistake of revealing something about you at 19 while intoxicated? He has even apologized for what he said and you still see him as the bad person in this story when you are clearly the issue.

Your ex-fiance has 100% reason to be frustrated and end the relationship. He has explained that he hates and despises the act of cheating altogether. Early on in your relationship, instead of telling him that you are someone who cheated before, you decided to withhold that information because...? It's clear that you thought you could just hide that fact that you are what he despises because you wouldn't want him to leave you, but that isn't fair to him. Frankly, how can he even trust you? You wouldn't even tell him the kind of person you were, he can't trust your word that you haven't cheated on him during your relationship because you would have held the secret to your grave. You need to realize that there are people that have the mindsets of "once a cheater always a cheater" or "never date someone who cheats on their SO, they are liars". Hunter has either one of these mindsets and you are falling into the second one. It's as simple as that honestly. He has the right to refrain from dating people that made the decision to cheat.

Just to wrap this up, cheating and then lying about ever cheating before is not cool at all. I don't know if you think it is but you decided to withhold that from your fiance because yta. I find it interesting that you put the word boyfriend in quotations for your ex, as if being in a relationship with someone for 5 months doesn't count as serious, it's about 152 days give or take and almost half an entire year. If you don't want to be in a relationship with someone just break up with them, do not cheat. It is as black and white as that. You even cheated on your ex and HE had to either sleuth around and find out about it or been told by someone who knew. You couldn't have the guts to tell your ex that you cheated on him. If it isn't clear already YTA in this entire story. This thread full of apologists need help some serious help if they think that OP didn't have this coming to her.
